programme.title: Inside Iran: War & Revolution
programme.desc: Following unprecedented protests and a devastating military conflict, Iranian citizens are risking their lives to share what truly happened inside their country. The film features exclusive, on-the-ground footage and interviews with ordinary people, journalists, and grieving families - many speaking anonymously - who survived the brutal 2026 uprising and subsequent war. Through their detailed first-hand accounts, this documentary - for the BAFTA-winning ITV Exposure strand - explores how the Islamic Republic's ruthless crackdown on civilian demonstrations escalated into a terrifying international crisis. Their testimonies expose harrowing scenes of internet blackouts, state-sanctioned killings of unarmed protesters, and the devastating reality of life under US and Israeli bombardment.
